# Flock GF(2^128) products, consumed as a cross-implementation reference.
#
# Source: github.com/succinctlabs/flock at commit b684b12, eprint 2026/1329.
# Produced by: cargo run --release --bin dump_ghash_vectors -- vectors.bin 256
# Only the first 128 records of that dump are kept here.
#
# Flock writes each element as two little-endian 64-bit words, low word first.
# Reassembling them as one 128-bit integer gives bit i holding the coefficient of x^i.
# That is already this crate's polynomial-basis convention, so no bit reversal applies.
# NIST GCM blocks are the opposite order and do need one; the contrast is the point.
#
# Each line is `a b product`, big-endian hex of that 128-bit integer, 32 digits each.
# The first five records are structured edge cases and the rest are pseudorandom.
